_about: Overlay for the ownership fixture tests (SPEC section 3). ps.txt and psargs.txt are a `ps` capture of a
developer Mac (2026-09-30). User, host and project names, and some third-party app names, are fictional stand-ins;
apps the tests depend on (Chrome, AeroSpace, SwiftBar, Hammerspoon, tmux, colima/lima, doppler) and some other
common apps keep their real names. `ps` shows no environment, start times or footprints, so this file adds them.
The CLAUDE_PID values reproduce what KERN_PROCARGS2 showed at capture time:
- the tmux server 51951 was started from session 21630 (now dead), so it and every pane shell carry CLAUDE_PID=21630;
- AeroSpace, SwiftBar, Hammerspoon (+ its aerospace child), limactl and an orphaned login shell were (re)started
- the bun/next dev server in pgid 7164 and the doppler/next dev server in pgid 40363 belong to dead sessions;
- every claude sets CLAUDE_PID=<its own pid> for the processes it starts.
The agent-browser daemon and its Chrome are not in ps.txt; they are added in the shape such a daemon has on a
live system (daemon reparented to launchd with CLAUDE_PID=80876; Chrome with --remote-debugging-port=0,
--headless=new and a scratch --user-data-dir; the Chrome itself has no CLAUDE_PID).
Footprint = RSS from the capture (the fixture has no phys_footprint), so byte totals are RSS-based.
